separator.semantics: Enumerate only proper list-respecting psi:S->[4]. For each psi, encode all boundary restrictions into component lists and apply only frozen deterministic propagation.

exact_components_before_boundary_propaga.robustness: Any boundary propagation only deletes colors and/or fixes vertices; every surviving induced subgraph remains a forest.

exact_components_before_boundary_propaga.terminal_reason: If all six vertices remain undecided, LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_EXACT_LIST_READY. If deterministic propagation fixes/deletes at least one Q_D vertex, every remaining component is an induced subgraph of K_{2,2,2}-v, hence has treewidth <=3 and is TW3_LIST_READY.
exact_components_before_boundary_propaga.width3_support: For K_{1,2,2}, a width-3 decomposition uses two size-4 bags: singleton part plus one vertex from the first 2-part plus both vertices of the second 2-part, then replace that first-part vertex by its mate. Every further induced subgraph inherits width <=3.

universal_branch_closure.statement: For every proper list-respecting boundary assignment psi on S, after frozen deterministic propagation each branch is either an exact contradiction or every surviving component is closed by the already-frozen terminal library.

complexity.per_state: Frozen propagation plus constant-size / fixed-treewidth terminal checks.
complexity.conclusion: Polynomial for this exact sealed witness.

theorem_for_current_witness.statement: The current Q2 Path-A witness is polynomially resolved by the explicit 4-vertex separator {z,a0,a1,b0}.
theorem_for_current_witness.connectivity_context: This separator also supplies the upper bound proving kappa(C)=4.
